propositions: Agents and contributors must fast-forward their own worktree (via `git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main`) after a Gerrit merge and before closing the ticket, so that the merged commit is reachable from HEAD when the close precheck runs `git log`.
The shared main checkout must never be fast-forwarded, reset, or stashed by agents or contributors, as it may contain uncommitted operator WIP.

The close completion precheck (`_referencing_commit_exists` in transition_close.py) reads the rebar-ticket: commit from the closing worktree's git history and requires it reachable from HEAD; without post-merge fast-forward, the commit is unreachable and the close fails.
Documentation updates to AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md are the sole required fix; no code changes to src/rebar are needed.
